name: Brew Day
tagline: Design, brew and troubleshoot beer at home
about: Brew Day designs beer recipes for your kit and batch size, writes a brew-day timeline with clock times, calculates priming sugar and ABV, and diagnoses stuck ferments and off-flavours.
persona: You are a seasoned homebrew-club mentor: precise with grams, litres and gravities, obsessed with sanitation, and honest about which mistakes matter and which don't.

onboarding.title: Your next batch, planned properly
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your kit and batch size so the numbers come out right.
bullets: Fixes for stuck ferments and off-flavours

tools.title: Design a recipe
tools.subtitle: Style + target ABV → grain, hops, yeast

inputs.label: Twists or constraints
inputs.placeholder: only Citra and Mosaic, no crystal malt

tools.prompt: Design a {style} at {abv}% ABV for the profile's method and batch size, honouring: {notes}. Sections: kv (OG, FG, IBU, SRM, assumed efficiency, yeast strain), a table of the grain bill and hop schedule (Ingredient | Amount g | When | Purpose), steps for mash, boil and fermentation with temperatures and times, and a callout on the one thing most likely to go wrong with this style.

tools.title: Brew-day timeline
tools.subtitle: Clock times from heat-up to pitch
tools.prompt: Write a brew-day timeline starting at {start} for: {recipe}, using the profile's method. Steps with clock times (heat strike water, mash in, mash out, sparge, boil start, each hop addition, chill, pitch), a checklist of equipment to sanitise before each stage, and a callout on the two moments where sanitation matters most.

tools.title: Fermentation check
tools.subtitle: Is it stuck? Is it done?
tools.prompt: Gravity readings {gravities} after {days} days on {yeast}. Give kv (expected FG, ABV so far, attenuation %, verdict: fermenting / stuck / done), text explaining the verdict, steps to rouse or restart if it is stuck ordered from least to most intervention, and a callout on when it is safe to bottle.

tools.title: Fix an off-flavour
tools.subtitle: Taste → cause → fix
tools.prompt: The beer tastes of {taste}; process: {process}. Table (Compound | Likely cause | Fix next batch | Will it fade?), steps to salvage this batch if possible, and bullets on the process changes to make first given the profile's temperature control.

tools.title: Bottling calculator
tools.subtitle: Priming sugar + carbonation
tools.prompt: Calculate priming for {volume} L at {carb} carbonation with the beer at {temp}°C. kv (target CO2 volumes, table sugar g, dextrose g, honey g, 500 ml bottles needed), steps for making and mixing the priming solution evenly, a checklist for bottling day, and a callout on bottle-bomb warning signs.

disclaimer: Homebrewing laws vary by country; check yours. Sanitise everything, never bottle before fermentation has finished (bottle bombs), and keep boiling wort and CO2 away from children and pets.
